    local volumeJitter = config.VolumeJitter or 0
    if pitchJitter > 0 then
        sound.PlaybackSpeed = math.max(0.05, prefab.PlaybackSpeed * (1 + rng:NextNumber(-pitchJitter, pitchJitter)))
    end

        sound.Volume = math.max(0, prefab.Volume * (1 + rng:NextNumber(-volumeJitter, volumeJitter)))
    end

    return sound, tempEmitter, prefab
end

local function playLocal(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
    local prefab = AudioHelper:GetEffectSound(name)
    if not prefab or not prefab:IsA("Sound") then
        return nil
    end

    local source = sourceToken(emitter, options)
    local throttleKey = sourceKey(name, source)
    local now = os.clock()
    local last = lastPlayed[throttleKey]
    if last and now - last < (config.MinInterval or 0) then
        stats.dropped += 1
        return nil
    end
    lastPlayed[throttleKey] = now

    local priority = priorityFor(name, config, emitter, options or {})
    local eviction = findEviction(config, priority, source)
    if eviction == false then
        stats.dropped += 1
        return nil
    end
    if eviction then
        stats.replaced += 1
        fadeReplace(eviction)
    end

    local sound, tempEmitter, sourcePrefab = prepareSound(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options or {}, config)
    if not sound then
        return nil
    end

    local record = {
        sound = sound,
        tempEmitter = tempEmitter,
        category = config.Category,
        source = source,
        priority = priority,
        startedAt = now,
        removed = false,
    }
    oneShots[sound] = record
    activeCount += 1
    stats.played += 1
    stats.peakActive = math.max(stats.peakActive, activeCount)
    byCategory[config.Category] = byCategory[config.Category] or {}
    table.insert(byCategory[config.Category], record)
    table.insert(activeRecords, record)
    playWhenReady(record, sourcePrefab, config)
    return sound
end

local function stopExclusive(key, pause)
    local entry = exclusive[key] or loops[key]
    if not entry then return end
    local sound = entry.sound
    if pause then
        sound:Pause()
    else
        sound:Stop()
        if sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end
        if entry.tempEmitter and entry.tempEmitter.Parent then entry.tempEmitter:Destroy() end
        if exclusive[key] == entry then
            exclusive[key] = nil
        end
        if loops[key] == entry then
            loops[key] = nil
            loopCount = math.max(0, loopCount - 1)
        end
    end
end

local function startExclusive(name, key, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, isLoop)
    if not key then
        key = name
    end
    if isLoop and loops[key] and loops[key].sound and loops[key].sound.Parent then
        return loops[key].sound
    end
    if not isLoop and not (options and options.ForceRestart) and exclusive[key] and exclusive[key].sound and exclusive[key].sound.Parent then
        local existingSound = exclusive[key].sound
        if existingSound.Playing then
            return existingSound
        end
        existingSound:Resume()
        return existingSound
    end
    if not isLoop then
        local requestedConfig = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
        if requestedConfig.Category == "Cinematic" then
            for otherKey in pairs(exclusive) do
                if otherKey ~= key then
                    stopExclusive(otherKey, false)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    stopExclusive(key, false)

    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
    local sound, tempEmitter, prefab = prepareSound(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options or {}, config)
    if not sound then return nil end

    if isLoop then
        if loopCount >= AudioConfig.Budgets.ControlledLoop then
            sound:Destroy()
            if tempEmitter then tempEmitter:Destroy() end
            return nil
        end
        sound.Looped = true
        loops[key] = {sound = sound, tempEmitter = tempEmitter}
        loopCount += 1
    else
        exclusive[key] = {sound = sound, tempEmitter = tempEmitter}
    end

    if beginLoad(sound, prefab) then
        sound:Play()
    else
        local loaded
        loaded = sound.Loaded:Connect(function()
            if loaded then
                loaded:Disconnect()
                loaded = nil
            end
            if sound.Parent then sound:Play() end
        end)
        task.delay(math.max(0.05, config.MaxStartDelay or 2), function()
            if not sound.Playing and sound.Parent then
                sound:Destroy()
                if tempEmitter and tempEmitter.Parent then tempEmitter:Destroy() end
                if isLoop then
                    if loops[key] and loops[key].sound == sound then
                        loops[key] = nil
                        loopCount = math.max(0, loopCount - 1)
                    end
                elseif exclusive[key] and exclusive[key].sound == sound then
                    exclusive[key] = nil
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        if not isLoop then
            if exclusive[key] and exclusive[key].sound == sound then
                exclusive[key] = nil
            end
        else
            if loops[key] and loops[key].sound == sound then
                loops[key] = nil
                loopCount = math.max(0, loopCount - 1)
            end
        end
        if sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end
        if tempEmitter and tempEmitter.Parent then tempEmitter:Destroy() end
    end)
    return sound
end

local function handleRemote(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    stats.received += 1
    options = options or {}
    local command = options._Command
    local key = options._ExclusiveKey

    if command == "StartExclusive" then
        startExclusive(name, key, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, false)
    elseif command == "PauseExclusive" then
        stopExclusive(key, true)
    elseif command == "StopExclusive" then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    elseif command == "StartLoop" then
        startExclusive(name, key, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, true)
    elseif command == "StopLoop" then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    elseif name then
        playLocal(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    end
end

if isClient then
    OnPlaySound.OnClientEvent:Connect(handleRemote)

    local preloadBatches = {
        {"吃东西", "Empty Gun Sound", "UIError", "抓起"},
        {"GunSound", "敌人手枪射击", "射箭", "近战武器Swing1"},
        {"近战武器Swing2", "近战武器Hit1", "近战武器Hit2", "雪球命中"},
    }
    task.defer(function()
        for _, batch in ipairs(preloadBatches) do
            local prefabs = {}
            for _, name in ipairs(batch) do
                local sound = AudioHelper:GetEffectSound(name)
                if sound and sound:IsA("Sound") then
                    table.insert(prefabs, sound)
                end
            end
            if #prefabs > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(prefabs)
                end)
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

function AudioHelper:PlayEffect(name, emitter, options)
    options = options or {}
    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
    if isClient then
        if config.PlaybackMode == "Exclusive" then
            return startExclusive(name, options.ExclusiveKey or options.SourceKey or name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, false)
        elseif config.PlaybackMode == "ControlledLoop" then
            return startExclusive(name, options.ExclusiveKey or options.SourceKey or name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, true)
        end
        return playLocal(name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options)
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options)
end

function AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player, name, emitter, options)
    options = copyOptions(options)
    if typeof(emitter) == "Vector3" then
        options.FallbackPosition = emitter
        emitter = nil
    elseif type(emitter) == "table" and options.FallbackPosition == nil then
        options = copyOptions(emitter)
        emitter = options.Emitter
        options.Emitter = nil
    end

    if isClient then
        if player == nil or player == Players.LocalPlayer then
            return playLocal(name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options)
        end
        return
    end

    if player then
        options.TargetUserId = player.UserId
        local config = AudioConfig:Get(name)
        if config and (config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local") then
            dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, resolvePosition(emitter, options.FallbackPosition), options)
            return
        end
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options)
end

function AudioHelper:PlayExclusive(name, key, emitter, options)
    options = copyOptions(options)
    options._ExclusiveKey = key
    if isClient then
        return startExclusive(name, key, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, false)
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options, "StartExclusive")
end

function AudioHelper:PauseExclusive(key)
    if isClient then
        stopExclusive(key, true)
    else
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(nil, nil, nil, {_Command = "PauseExclusive", _ExclusiveKey = key})
    end
end

function AudioHelper:StopExclusive(key)
    if isClient then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    else
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(nil, nil, nil, {_Command = "StopExclusive", _ExclusiveKey = key})
    end
end

function AudioHelper:StartLoop(name, key, emitter, options)
    options = copyOptions(options)
    options._ExclusiveKey = key
    if isClient then
        return startExclusive(name, key, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, true)
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options, "StartLoop")
end

function AudioHelper:StopLoop(key)
    if isClient then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    else
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(nil, nil, nil, {_Command = "StopLoop", _ExclusiveKey = key})
    end
end

function AudioHelper:GetDebugStats()
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(stats) do
        copy[key] = value
    end
    copy.active = activeCount
    copy.pendingLoads = pendingLoads
    return copy
end

function AudioHelper:BindPlaySoundEvent(callback)
    if isClient and callback then
        return OnPlaySound.OnClientEvent:Connect(callback)
    end
end

function AudioHelper:BindCharacterWalkSound(character, name)
    if not character or not character:IsA("Model") or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return
    end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not root then return end

    humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
        local sound = root:FindFirstChild("WalkSound")
        if not sound then
            local soundPrefab = SoundService:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not soundPrefab or not soundPrefab:IsA("Sound") then return end
            sound = soundPrefab:Clone()
            sound.Name = "WalkSound"
            sound.Looped = true
            sound.Parent = root
        end

        if speed > 0 and not sound.Playing then
            sound:Play()
        elseif speed <= 0 and sound.Playing then
            sound:Stop()
        end
    end)
end

    local v = ValueHelper:WaitValue(ins, value)
    return v and v.Value or nil
end

function ValueHelper:SetValue(ins:Instance,valueObject:ValueBase,value:any)
    local valueBase = ValueHelper:WaitValue(ins, valueObject)
    valueBase.Value = value
end

function ValueHelper:Reset(ins:Instance,model:Configuration)
    if not ins then return end
    
    local root = ins:FindFirstChild(_RootName)
    if not root then return end

    for _,tempV:ValueBase in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        local v:ValueBase = root:FindFirstChild(tempV.Name)
        if v then
            v.Value = tempV.Value
        end
    end
end

    local v_obj:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(ins,valueObject)
    if not v_obj then return end

    local v_bonus:NumberValue = v_obj:FindFirstChild(bonusName)
    if not v_bonus then
        v_bonus = Instance.new("NumberValue")
        v_bonus.Name = bonusName
        v_bonus.Parent = v_obj

        -- v_bonus.Changed:Connect(function()

        --     for _,v_b:NumberValue in ipairs(v_obj:GetChildren()) do
        --         newValue += v_b.Value

        -- end)
    end
    if v_bonus.Value ~= value then
        v_bonus.Value = value

        -- 重新计算总值
        local newValue = 0
        for _,v_b:NumberValue in ipairs(v_obj:GetChildren()) do
            newValue += v_b.Value
        end
        v_obj.Value = newValue
    end
end

function ValueHelper:GetBonusValueValue(ins:Instance,valueObject:ValueBase,bonusName:string)

    if not v_obj then return 0 end

    if not v_obj then return 0 end

    local v_bonus:NumberValue = v_obj:WaitForChild(bonusName)

function AccessoryHelper:Equip(player:Player,item:Model)
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
    if not resLo then return end
    -- 销毁场景道具
    ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,resLo.id)
end
function AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player:Player,id:number)
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
    if not resLo then return end
    -- 脱掉原有的饰品
    AccessoryHelper:Discard(player,resLo.ItemType)

    local character = player.Character
    if resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Chestplate then
        -- 记录新的胸甲
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId,resLo.id)
    elseif resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.FaceMask then
        -- 记录新面罩
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId,resLo.id)
        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonResistance,resLo.ItemType,tonumber(resLo.param) or 0)
    elseif resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Scarf then
        -- 记录新的围巾
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId,resLo.id)
        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.freezeResistance,resLo.ItemType,tonumber(resLo.param) or 0)
    elseif resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Shoe then
        -- 记录新鞋子
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId,resLo.id)
        -- ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,resLo.ItemType,tonumber(resLo.param) or 0)
        character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ImmunityMud)
    end

    -- 创建饰品
    local prefab = ResourcesItemHelper:GetPrefab(resLo.id)
    for _,child:Accessory in ipairs(prefab:GetChildren()) do
        if not child:IsA("Accessory") then continue end
        local accessory:Accessory = child:Clone()
        -- 屏蔽饰品的碰撞
        CommonFunc:SetCanCollision(accessory,false)
        accessory:AddTag(resLo.ItemType)
        accessory.Parent = character
    end

end

function AccessoryHelper:Discard(player:Player,itemType:string)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    for _,accessory:Accessory in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
            if accessory:HasTag(itemType) then
                if itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Chestplate then
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId,0)
                elseif itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.FaceMask then
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId,0)
                    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonResistance,itemType,0)
                elseif itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Scarf then
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId,0)
                    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.freezeResistance,itemType,0)
                elseif itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Shoe then
                    -- 记录新鞋子
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId,0)
                    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,itemType,0)
                    character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.ImmunityMud)
                end

                accessory:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end

    local def = 0

    if chestplateId and chestplateId > 0 then
        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(chestplateId)
        if resLo and resLo.param then
            local values = resLo.param:split(",")
            def = tonumber(values[1])
        end
    end
    return def
end

    local lv = 0
    if itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Chestplate then

        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
        if resLo and resLo.lv then

    return lv
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local ConfigHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("ConfigHelper"))

function CraftItemHelper:Init()
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("蓝图")
    for _,child:Instance in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        CommonFunc:SetAllScriptEnabled(child,false)
    end
end

function CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(item:Model)
    if not item then return end
    return item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BluePrint)
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item:Model)
    item = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(item,GameEnum.Tag.BluePrint)
    if not item then return end
    local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(item,DragItemValue.id)
    local lo:CraftItemSetting.Type = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)
    return lo
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetLoByCraft(craft:Model)
    local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(craft,CraftValue.id)
    local lo:CraftItemSetting.Type = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)
    return lo
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id:number)
    local lo:CraftItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CraftItemSetting,id)
    return lo
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimesTag(id:number)
    local tag = string.format("Craft_%d",id)
    return tag
end

function CraftItemHelper:CreateItem(id:number,parent:Instance?)
    local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)

    local itemType:string = GameEnum.Tag.BluePrint
    local prefab = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("Resources"):WaitForChild("107")
    local item:Tool = prefab:Clone()
    item.Name = lo.ItemName
    item.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(item,DragItemValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(item,DragItemValue.id,id)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(item,DragItemValue.itemType,itemType)

    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)
    item:AddTag(itemType)
    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tool)

    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(item,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.ResourcesItem)

    if not parent then
        item.Parent = workspace
    end

    return item
end

function CraftItemHelper:DestroyCraft(craft:Instance,lifeTime:number?)
    if not craft then return end
    if not craft:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Craft) then return end
    if not lifeTime then lifeTime = 0 end

    -- 粉碎
    if lifeTime > 0 then
        -- 清理所有Tag
        local tags = craft:GetTags()
        for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
            craft:RemoveTag(tag)
        end

        -- 粉碎掉
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(math.min(lifeTime * 0.5,1),Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
        for _,child:Instance in ipairs(craft:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                local basePart:BasePart = child
                if basePart.Transparency == 1 then continue end
                basePart.Anchored = false
                basePart.CanCollide = true
                basePart.CanQuery = false
                basePart.CanTouch = false
                basePart.Massless = true
                local randomVec3 = CommonFunc:RandomVector3(20)
                basePart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(randomVec3.X,20,randomVec3.Z)
                -- basePart:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(Vector3.yAxis * 50,basePart.Position)
                TweenService:Create(basePart,tweenInfo,{
                    Transparency = 1
                }):Play()
            elseif child:IsA("Script") or child:IsA("WeldConstraint") or child:IsA("JointInstance") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end

        -- 延迟置空
        task.delay(lifeTime,function()
            craft.Parent = nil
        end)
    else
        craft.Parent = nil
    end
    Debris:AddItem(craft,lifeTime + 2)
end

function CraftItemHelper:DestroyTool(tool:Tool)
    if not CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(tool) then return end
    local tags = tool:GetTags()
    for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
        tool:RemoveTag(tag)
    end
    tool.Parent = nil
    Debris:AddItem(tool,2)
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetCraftParent()
    local mapParent:Folder
    if RunService:IsServer() then
        mapParent = workspace:FindFirstChild("Crafts")
        if not mapParent then
            mapParent = Instance.new("Folder")
            mapParent.Name = "Crafts"
            mapParent.Parent = workspace
        end
    else
        mapParent = workspace:WaitForChild("Crafts")
    end
    return mapParent
end

function CraftItemHelper:CreateCraft(id:number,parent:Instance?,builder:Player?)
    local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)

    local prefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("蓝图"):WaitForChild(lo.prefabName or tostring(lo.id))
    local craft:Model = prefab:Clone()
    craft.Name = lo.ItemName

    if RunService:IsServer() then
        ValueHelper:InitByModel(craft,CraftValue)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(craft,CraftValue.id,id)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(craft,CraftValue.builder,builder)
        craft:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Craft)
        if lo.ItemType then
            craft:AddTag(lo.ItemType)
        end
        if lo.HP then
            craft:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DestructibleCraft)

            local v_hp:IntValue = craft:FindFirstChild("HP")
            if not v_hp then
                v_hp = Instance.new("NumberValue")
                v_hp.Name = "HP"
                v_hp.Parent = craft
            end
            local v_hpMax:IntValue = craft:FindFirstChild("HPMax")
            if not v_hpMax then
                v_hpMax = Instance.new("NumberValue")
                v_hpMax.Name = "HPMax"
                v_hpMax.Parent = craft
            end
            v_hp.Value = lo.HP
            v_hpMax.Value = lo.HP
        end
    else
        -- 关闭交互
        CommonFunc:ForDescendant(prefab,function(ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt)
            if ProximityPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                ProximityPrompt.Enabled = false
            end
        end)
    end

    craft.Parent = parent or CraftItemHelper:GetCraftParent()

    return craft
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetCraftHPValue(craft:Model)
    local v_hp:IntValue = craft:FindFirstChild("HP")
    return v_hp
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetBuilder(craft:Model)
    local builder:Player = nil
    if craft:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Craft) then
        builder = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(craft,CraftValue.builder)
    end
    return builder
end

function CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(id:number)
    local craftingbench = MapHelper:GetCraftingBench()
    if RunService:IsServer() then
        local folder:Folder = craftingbench:FindFirstChild("CraftMakeTimes")
        if not folder then return end
        local name = tostring(id)
        local v_times:IntValue = folder:FindFirstChild(name)

        return v_times
    else
        local v_times:IntValue = craftingbench:WaitForChild("CraftMakeTimes"):WaitForChild(tostring(id))
        return v_times
    end
end

function CraftItemHelper:SetMakeTimes(id:number,value:number)

        local craftingbench = MapHelper:GetCraftingBench()
        local folder:Folder = craftingbench:FindFirstChild("CraftMakeTimes")
        if not folder then
            folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            folder.Name = "CraftMakeTimes"
            folder.Parent =craftingbench

        local v_times:IntValue = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not v_times then
            v_times = Instance.new("IntValue")
            v_times.Name = name
            v_times.Parent = folder
        end
        v_times.Value = value

        CraftItemHelper.onMakeTimesChanged:Fire(id,value)
    end
end
